config_file.description: Path to an unbound.conf file to prime libunbound. Leave empty to use no config file.

dns_class.description: Specify the DNS class to lookup (e.g., IN, CH). Leave empty for default.

dns_type.description: Specify the record type to lookup (e.g., A, AAAA, MX). Leave empty for default.

dnssec_validation.description: Enable DNSSEC validation reading root anchor from default location.

hostname.description: The hostname or IP address to resolve.

key_file.description: Path to a file containing DS or DNSKEY records. Leave empty if not used.

named_key_file.description: Path to a BIND-style named.conf file with trusted-key entries. Leave empty if not used.

trust_anchors.description: List of trust anchor keys (DS or DNSKEY records) to use. If empty, relies on other methods or defaults if DNSSEC validation is on.

use_ipv4.description: Use solely IPv4 network for sending packets.

use_ipv6.description: Use solely IPv6 network for sending packets.

verbose.description: Enable verbose output and show validation status (secure, insecure, bogus).
